description: Add Demo route to App.jsx routing configuration

userStories.title: Add Demo route to App.jsx
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to add a /demo route to the app so that the Demo page is accessible via navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: Import statement `import Demo from './pages/Demo';` is added at the top of src/App.jsx
A new `<Route path='/demo' element={<Demo />} />` is added inside the existing `<Routes>` block after the Hello World route
Existing Home and Hello World routes are unchanged
The new route is correctly nested within the `<Routes>` wrapper
